The Evidence is insufficient to establish identity for any subject, including the customer whose entity resolution is NEEDS_REVIEW with null entity_id.

Seabright's voting-majority control right (60% voting) over Atlantic Meridian is asserted only in a finding; the sole ownership evidence shows 0.45 equity and no voting rights. No record evidences the voting arrangement, and control.resolve left the right unresolved.

Findings risk-edd-review:3, risk-edd-review:5 and relationship-product-review:2 are missing from the record set. An absent record is a challenge, not a pass; the person must obtain or account for them.

The legal status of the synthetic list and the sufficiency of real-list coverage must be confirmed before the hits or the non-hits are given legal weight.

No as-of date or list version is recorded for any screening list or for the SPECIMEN verification evidence beyond a uniform observed_at of 2026-09-30; currency of the sanctions subsets and registry extracts cannot be assessed.

The customer holds correspondent (SWIFT), custody and payments products with a baseline for payments only and no stated rationale for correspondent or custody; the source-of-funds claim is unverified and no source-of-wealth record exists. Product approval and SoF/SoW requirements appear unmet.
